title: Fill missing values with column mean
instruction: Define a function `fill_nan_with_mean(data)` that takes a 2D NumPy array with possible NaN values and returns a new array where each NaN is replaced with the mean of its column. Use np.nanmean(data, axis=0).
solution_code:
import numpy as np

def fill_nan_with_mean(data):
    result = data.copy()
    col_mean = np.nanmean(data, axis=0)
    for col in range(data.shape[1]):
        mask = np.isnan(result[:, col])
        result[mask, col] = col_mean[col]
    return result
test_suite:
import numpy as np

SAMPLE = np.array([[1., 2., np.nan], [4., np.nan, 6.], [7., 8., 9.]])

def test_fills_nan():
    result = exercise.fill_nan_with_mean(SAMPLE)
    expected = np.array([[1., 2., 7.5], [4., 5., 6.], [7., 8., 9.]])
    assert np.allclose(result, expected), f"Expected:\n{expected}\nGot:\n{result}"

def test_no_nan():
    data = np.array([[1., 2.], [3., 4.]])
    result = exercise.fill_nan_with_mean(data)
    assert np.allclose(result, data), f"Should return copy when no NaN"

def test_original_unchanged():
    orig = SAMPLE.copy()
    _ = exercise.fill_nan_with_mean(SAMPLE)
    mask = ~np.isnan(SAMPLE)
    assert np.allclose(SAMPLE[mask], orig[mask]), "Should not modify original"

def test_all_nan_column():
    data = np.array([[1., np.nan], [3., np.nan]])
    result = exercise.fill_nan_with_mean(data)
    assert np.isnan(result[0, 1]), "All NaN column should stay NaN"
    assert np.isnan(result[1, 1]), "All NaN column should stay NaN"

def test_returns_ndarray():
    result = exercise.fill_nan_with_mean(SAMPLE)
    assert isinstance(result, np.ndarray), f"Expected numpy.ndarray, got {type(result)}"

title: Standardize a dataset
instruction: Define a function `standardize(data)` that takes a 1D NumPy array and returns a standardized version (mean 0, std 1). Formula: (data - mean) / std
test_suite:
import numpy as np

def test_basic():
    data = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50], dtype=float)
    result = exercise.standardize(data)
    expected = np.array([-1.41421356, -0.70710678, 0., 0.70710678, 1.41421356])
    assert np.allclose(result, expected, atol=1e-5), f"Expected {expected}, got {result}"

def test_mean_zero():
    data = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50], dtype=float)
    result = exercise.standardize(data)
    assert abs(result.mean()) < 1e-10, f"Mean should be ~0, got {result.mean()}"

def test_std_one():
    data = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50], dtype=float)
    result = exercise.standardize(data)
    assert abs(result.std() - 1.0) < 1e-10, f"Std should be ~1, got {result.std()}"

def test_constant():
    data = np.array([5, 5, 5, 5])
    result = exercise.standardize(data)
    assert np.all(np.isnan(result)) or np.all(np.isinf(result)), f"Expected NaN or inf"

def test_negative():
    data = np.array([-5, 0, 5])
    result = exercise.standardize(data)
    assert abs(result.mean()) < 1e-10, f"Mean should be ~0"
    assert abs(result.std() - 1.0) < 1e-10, f"Std should be ~1"
